description: This file implements a WebSocket-based GatewaySession class for managing connections, authentication, and messaging with a remote gateway server, including handling authorization, reconnection logic, and event handling. It contains data classes, internal classes, and functions supporting connection setup, request/response processing, and event processing within an Android application environment.

classes.name: GatewayClientInfo
classes.description: Holds information about the Gateway client configuration such as id, version, platform, etc.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Defines connection options including role, scopes, capabilities, commands, permissions, and client info.

classes.name: GatewayConnectErrorDetails
classes.description: Provides details about connection errors, including error codes and retry suggestions.

classes.name: SelectedConnectAuth
classes.description: Represents selected authentication information for establishing a connection, including tokens and auth source.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Main class managing the WebSocket-based session with the gateway server, handling connection lifecycle, requests, responses, events, and reconnection logic.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeRequest
classes.description: Represents an invocation request sent through the gateway, including command parameters.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an invocation, including success status, payload, and possible error.

classes.name: GatewaySession.ErrorShape
classes.description: Details about an error encountered during gateway communication, including code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Internal class representing a single WebSocket connection to the gateway, managing connection state, message handling, and request/response transactions.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a gateway connection with specified parameters, setting desired connection state.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the current connection and cleans up session state.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Triggers a reconnection attempt on the current connection.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends an event with optional JSON payload to the connected node.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an RPC request over the WebSocket connection with a timeout.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests a refresh of the node's canvas capability URL.
